todo1.title: TODO 1: getDistance
whereToLook: Day 3 notes, FD1 (One task per method): getGallons is an input method. It receives the Scanner, prints a prompt, and returns what the user typed.
In the call, keyboard is a Scanner, so the parameter is a Scanner. The result is stored in meters, an int, so the method returns an int.
Use print, not println, so the user types on the same line as the prompt.

todo2.title: TODO 2: showMenu
whereToLook: The call showMenu(); stands alone as a statement, and nothing is stored, so showMenu is void.
Nothing goes inside the parentheses in the call, so the header has no parameters.
Check each menu line against the README, including the period after each number.

todo3.title: TODO 3: showResult
whereToLook: Day 3 notes, FD1 (One task per method): displayResults is an output method. It's void and takes the values it displays.
Look at the showResult call under TODO 4. The arguments are meters (an int), kilometers (a double), and "kilometers" (a String). The parameters match them in the same order.
The line ends with the unit and a period: 500 meters is 0.5 kilometers.

todo4.title: TODO 4: calcKilometers
whereToLook: Day 3 notes, FD1 (One task per method): gallonsToLiters is a calculation method. It takes a value and returns the result, with no printing.
The result is stored in kilometers, a double, so the method returns a double. The argument meters is an int.
Use the formula from the README: meters * 0.001.

todo5.title: TODO 5: calcFeet
whereToLook: calcFeet has the same shape as calcKilometers: an int goes in, a double comes back.
Use the formula from the README: meters * 3.281.

todo6.title: TODO 6: calcInches
whereToLook: Day 1 notes, M3 (A method that calls a method): checkEngines calls checkFuel, waits for it to finish, then continues.
calcInches has the same header shape as calcFeet. Inside it, call calcFeet with the meters and multiply what it sends back by 12.
Don't use 39.37. The inches should come from calcFeet.
